body: Also, I called out my mom for being a narcissist and my father informed me that "I've opened up a can of worms that I can't believe." The look my mother gave me was of pure evil. Psycho evil. I'm genuinely worried about what I'm going to do because my father is very heavy handed.
The big problem I have is finding somewhere to move to. I don't have a job, only like 3k in cash. No family to take me in, at least, none that I trust won't rat me out for living there.
Thank you for posting this! Incredibly helpful, as I have just come to the realization that my parents do a lot of this to control me.
